agent_explanation: At step 28 bodies 0 and 1 are touching (gap 0.005) with controller force only 6.56. The fast intruder collides and impulsively kicks controlled body 0 from speed ~2.9 to ~10.27 at step 29. The waypoint velocity-error law kp*velocity-error then demands ~486.9 N, far above fmax 72.67, because the commanded force is computed from post-impact velocity error without clamping to fmax. Moving the intruder away (counterfactual) removes the impact and the spike.
